## Summary

Created `ledger/importer.py` with the `import_csv` function that:

- Parses CSV text with lines of `account,amount` (no header)
- Skips blank lines
- Posts one entry per line to the ledger using `ledger.post()`
- Handles whitespace in both accounts and amounts
- Uses `Money.from_str()` to safely parse decimal amounts
- Returns the count of entries posted

The implementation correctly handles the edge cases (blank lines, whitespace) and all existing tests continue to pass. The function has been validated with sample CSV data showing proper parsing and balance calculations.
